deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is January 31 for admission; Priority 2 is April 15. The page gives no department-specific deadline.

gre_general.value: Biology catalog: GRE is required for doctoral applicants but can be waived case by case; the Ph.D. minimum is 310 quantitative plus verbal.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is required, but it can be waived on case by case bases for qualified applicants. | Ph.D.: 310 (quantitative + verbal), 3.0 (analytical writing)

gre_subject.value: Subject exams are strongly encouraged for applicants to the molecular biochemistry and biophysics doctorate; the biology PhD has no subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants to the doctoral program in molecular biochemistry and biophysics are strongly encouraged to take one of the subject exams in biology, molecular biology, chemistry, or physics.

toefl_min.value: Department catalog minimum is TOEFL iBT 80 (internet-based) or 550 (paper-based).

supervisor.value: No official page says a supervisor must be agreed before admission.

funding.value: Departmental funding goes to a limited number of applicants at admission, per the Graduate College.
funding.quote: Departmental funding is awarded to a limited number of highly qualified, full-time students at the time of admission.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor's degree in biology or a closely allied major.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to one of the department's programs (biology or molecular biochemistry and biophysics) are expected to have a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution with a major in that same discipline

notes: The biology PhD covers biology, molecular biochemistry and biophysics.
